raw_resume.summary: Software Engineer (Full Stack) with 5+ years of professional experience in backend and frontend development. Seeking the Software Engineer II, Google Cloud role to contribute to distributed systems and large-scale product development using Java, JavaScript, and cloud technologies.

bullets: Built Spring Boot services for shipment tracking that process 2 million events a day from Kafka.
Developed React and TypeScript screens for the dispatcher console used by 300 operators.
Containerised 5 services with Docker and deployed them to Kubernetes on AWS.
Added contract tests between the tracking API and the console, catching 9 breaking changes before release.
Automated 80 checkout regression tests with Selenium and Java.
Ran JMeter load tests for the festive-sale release.

projects.name: A11y Audit Helper
projects.description: React and TypeScript browser extension that flags missing alt text and low-contrast elements on a page.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with Python or C++ to match the JD's programming language requirements and strengthen your candidacy for Google Cloud roles.
Deepen your system design expertise by studying large-scale distributed systems architecture; document any experience you gain with designing or optimizing systems at scale.

Formalise your code review practices: lead design reviews with peers, document feedback patterns, and highlight this in future roles to align with the responsibility of reviewing code and giving feedback.
raw_resume.growth_note: You have strong full-stack and cloud infrastructure experience (Java, JavaScript, Kubernetes, AWS) that aligns well with the role. However, the JD emphasises Python and C++ as primary languages, and you lack demonstrated experience in system design and distributed systems at the depth Google typically expects for SDE II. Consider gaining Python proficiency and deepening your distributed systems knowledge to strengthen your fit.
